verdict: Qualified feasibility for cooperative local journal, artifact adoption, sealed admission and same-file handoff; not production-ready automatic resource management.

Real bytes-preserving artifact import and guarded physical mismatch handling
Sealed exact-plan-byte apply resists pathname substitution
Pre-effect resource census and explicit fixture expression admission

Manager receipts and durable execution bundles remain sidecars
Raw state/metadata confidentiality and global erasure are not established
Coarse fences can block unrelated work indefinitely
No native DML integration, cloud-resource test or distributed safety proof
